answer: Implemented tools/launcher/explicit_interpreter.py: each script is launched as <resolved-interpreter> <script>, never as a bare path. The resolver consults MSYS PATH and Windows/System32 PATH separately for the name 'bash'. MSYS resolved to /home/prekzursil/p2-g1/command-center/p2-wave/probes/IMP-0461/fixtures/estate/Git/usr/bin/bash (family=msys); system/WSL resolved to /home/prekzursil/p2-g1/command-center/p2-wave/probes/IMP-0461/fixtures/estate/Windows/System32/bash (family=wsl-system). The two absolute paths disagree. Concatenating PATH and taking the first hit hides the second bash (wrong-bash-resolved control). A CRLF script exits 127 under the real (wsl-system) interpreter and 0 under the tolerant MSYS wrapper. Bare invocation is refused. SENTINEL:IMP-0461:INTERPRETER-EXPLICIT
